app.name: Decarbonisation Navigator
page.ship.title: Ship
page.ship.lede: Pick a real ship from the EU MRV database by IMO number or name, or a standard ship from the ship-type library.
page.measures.title: Measures & fuels
page.measures.lede: Library of technologies and fuels with minimum, most likely and maximum values for every quantity, each with a source. Single measures and bundles over time.
page.decision.title: Decision (MCDA)
page.decision.lede: Criteria weights (BWM, AHP, entropy, CRITIC) and ranking of alternatives (SAW, TOPSIS, PROMETHEE II, VIKOR).
page.uncertainty.title: Uncertainty (SMAA)
page.uncertainty.lede: Tens of thousands of scenarios for weights, carbon prices, IMO NZF adoption and uncertain data: how often each alternative wins.
page.report.title: Report
page.report.lede: PDF report and Excel workbook with every result, ready for the board.
reg.title: Carbon regulations
reg.lede: Compliance cost year by year to 2050 under the EU ETS, FuelEU Maritime and the IMO Net-Zero Framework, plus the CII rating. Every parameter has a source and a check date.

ship.no_data.body: Download the yearly files from THETIS-MRV (mrv.emsa.europa.eu → Emission reports) into one folder and import it. Importing is done once and takes a few seconds; newer EMSA releases replace older ones.

ship.pick: Select a ship from the list.
ship.chart.title: CO2 EMISSIONS BY YEAR AND VOYAGE CATEGORY (t)
ship.mrv_note: EU MRV covers only voyages to, from and within the EU and time in EU ports. The ship's emissions on other voyages are not published.
import.title: Import EU MRV data
import.choose: Choose the folder with EMSA's .xlsx files
import.none: No .xlsx files found in the folder.
import.done: Imported {n} years. Skipped {skipped} (the same or a newer release is already present).
ets.from_mrv: Data from EU MRV: {name} (IMO {imo}), year {year}. Gross tonnage is not published; whether the ship falls under the ETS is taken from EMSA's figures.
ets.ratio: EMSA counts {pct} of the emissions the general rule gives for this ship (route exemptions such as islands). The ratio is applied until {until}; full coverage is assumed afterwards.
top.view.tip: EU: recorded EU MRV data only. WW: adds an estimate of activity outside the EU for the IMO rules.
in.domestic.more: The IMO Net-Zero Framework does not apply to ships on domestic voyages only. For EU MRV ships it is suggested automatically when every voyage is between EU ports and EMSA counts less than 20% of the emissions for the ETS (the pattern of an island service). Check it.
in.fuel.more.oil: Estimated from EU MRV data: the ship's CO2-to-fuel ratio ({cf} t/t) lies between heavy fuel oil (3.114) and marine gas oil (3.206), so the mix is split in proportion. EU MRV does not publish fuel types; change it if you know it.
in.fuel.more.lng: Estimated from EU MRV data: the CO2-to-fuel ratio ({cf} t/t) indicates LNG (2.750) with marine gas oil as second fuel. The engine type, which sets methane slip, is an assumption; change it if you know it.
in.eu_share: Share of activity in the EU (%)
ww.method.eu_dominant: Trades mainly in the EU: data taken as complete
ww.method.unknown: No estimate available; enter a value
ww.more: EU MRV records only voyages that touch an EU port. The IMO rules need total activity, which is not published. Estimate: EU MRV time at sea {hours} h ÷ ({days} typical days at sea for the ship type × 24) = {share}. Range with ±20% on the days: {low}–{high}. The typical days are provisional until checked against the Fourth IMO GHG Study. If you know the actual share, enter it. The EU ETS and FuelEU are not affected; nor is CII, because emissions and distance scale together.
in.nzf.more: The adoption vote is scheduled for 4 December 2026. Targets and prices: MEPC 83 draft. Targets after 2035, prices after 2030 and the value of surplus units are not yet set; the assumptions used are marked in Parameters.
cii.need_capacity: The CII rating needs the CII ship type, capacity and distance. EU MRV does not publish capacity; enter it in the ship details.
cii.more: CII is computed with the operating profile of the reference year, held constant. Reduction factors to 2030 from IMO; after 2030 an assumption (+2.625 points a year). Ships rated E, or D for three consecutive years, need a corrective action plan.
